expert_blurbs.author: headChopper
expert_blurbs.text: At home with a huge team total and in a prime bounce-back spot after underperforming in a tough Monday night game.

players.notes: Home rebound spot after a sluggish Monday game for an offense carrying a 29-point team total.

expert_blurbs.author: vanekjordan
expert_blurbs.text: The Cardinals generate pressure at one of the lowest rates in the NFL, and Jayden Daniels' yards per attempt jumps from 4.81 under pressure to 8.04 when kept clean. Washington's pass catchers have also started to find their rhythm following Terry McLaurin's injury, making this a great spot for Daniels and the Commanders' passing attack.

players.notes: Faces a low-pressure Arizona front, boosting his yards per attempt from 4.81 pressured to 8.04 clean.

expert_blurbs.author: ebeimfohr
expert_blurbs.text: The Ravens defense has collapsed, struggling against the lowly Chargers and the Panthers in b2b weeks, but their offense with Jacoby Brissett has shown enough ability to push opposing offenses. The Texans still struggle mightily to run the football no matter the matchup, which has them leaning heavily on Stroud and the passing game. Stroud has played great football, and Nico has re-emerged as his clear alpha the last two weeks in both targets and routes. We've seen the ceiling from both of these players to win tournaments, but the field is gravitating elsewhere for their pass game stacks.

players.notes: Houston's stagnant run game forces heavy pass volume against a collapsing Baltimore defense.

expert_blurbs.author: NeilCO
expert_blurbs.text: McCarthy goes from one of the toughest matchups in the league to one of the best, but his ownership doesn't reflect it. McCarthy is a risk-taker, and that's a trait I love in a cheap quarterback against a terrible defense. He also has shown a willingness to run. I'm expecting big games for McCarthy and his top pass catchers.

expert_blurbs.text: The fact that Skattebo was back in the game and taking the final handoffs after fumbling last week tells me the coaching staff has regained its trust in him. This is also starting to become a cakewalk of a matchup for opposing running backs against Indy.

expert_blurbs.author: NeilCO
expert_blurbs.text: Skattebo is just getting all the work for the Giants lately, and it's a great matchup.

expert_blurbs.author: vanekjordan
expert_blurbs.text: The Dolphins have been a stingy defense, but the losses along their defensive line should be felt in this matchup. The Bills didn't commit to the run game last week the way I had hoped, but I don't expect the Jets to make that same mistake. Breece Hall should see a heavy workload against this depleted defensive front.

expert_blurbs.author: ebeimfohr
expert_blurbs.text: The Dolphins defense has held up this season, but their injuries up front have me more bullish on opposing run games. The Jets have continued to be crazy run, and Breece is back as the lead back ahead of Braelon Allen.

expert_blurbs.author: ebeimfohr
expert_blurbs.text: Cameron has been sneaky productive in a bit of a limited role with a healthy Parker Washington, but Liam Coen expects him to step into a bigger role with Parker injured. He already has 111 receiving yards and a TD over the last two games, and he gets another matchup with the woeful Titans defense and fast paced offense.

expert_blurbs.text: The Commanders are one of the worst teams in the NFL at defending TEs and while McBride hasn't been great, the workload/matchup is perfect this weekend.

expert_blurbs.author: ebeimfohr
expert_blurbs.text: With Parker Washington out and Bhayshul Tuten trending out, the Jags are going to be extremely popular. But Jakobi Meyers, Chris Rodriguez and Josh Cameron appear to be generating most of the interest, opening the door for Strange to bring down the chalk at an extremely weak TE position in a great matchup. The Titans have the worst defense in the league, Washington leaves behind 25% of the team's targets on the season. I expect them to lean a bit more heavily into 12 personnel, something they have already run 25% of the time this season, which could create a big spike in targets for Strange, just as we've seen in other weeks this season when alpha WRs miss (Schultz, Hockenson, etc.).

expert_blurbs.text: Likely hasn't been producing as much since J.J. McCarthy took over. But he did see 11 targets in Week 10 before the terrible Week 11 matchup. Now, Likely gets a Colts defense that has allowed the 9th-most schedule-adjusted fantasy points per game to tight ends over the last 5 weeks.
